description: This Dart source file defines the Env class, which manages environment variables for configuring a Flutter application's backend URLs, authentication paths, and mock mode. It includes methods to load environment variables from a .env file with defaults and provides static getters to access configuration values throughout the app.

classes.name: Env
classes.description: A utility class for loading and accessing environment configuration variables such as URLs, paths, and modes, with support for defaults and fallback mechanisms.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Asynchronously loads environment variables from the .env file, applying default values if loading fails. Should be called before runApp to ensure configuration is ready.

methods.name: authLoginPath
methods.description: Returns the authentication login path, defaulting to '/auth/login' if not specified.

methods.name: mePaths
methods.description: Returns a list of user profile related endpoints, either from environment variable or default list.

methods.name: apiBaseUrl
methods.description: Returns the base URL for API requests, falling back to a default if not specified.

methods.name: realtimeUrl
methods.description: Returns the WebSocket URL for real-time communication, with a default fallback.

methods.name: eventsUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL for event streaming, with a default fallback.

methods.name: mockMode
methods.description: Returns a boolean indicating if mock mode is enabled, based on environment variable or default.
